d: BJ leads the kids in a day of ball games teaching coordination teamwork sharing and staying active through fun sports play.
Barney leads the children on a number hunt helping them discover numbers everywhere in their daily world and activities.

st: A Wonderful World of Colors and Shapes
d: An art show helps the children explore shapes colors creativity and artistic expression through fun and hands-on learning.
Barney and the children help Baby Bop learn to spell her name using music games practice and lots of encouragement.
The children proudly share their talents in an I Can Do show celebrating confidence individuality and creativity.
Barney and the children welcome a new friend teaching kindness inclusion and the importance of making others feel comfortable.
Firefighter Bill teaches the children about fire safety emergency helpers and staying prepared in case of danger.
Barney and the children explore vehicles and racing and BJ even participates in a real car race learning about safety and sportsmanship.

st: My Friends, The Doctor and Dentist
d: Barney shows the importance of brushing teeth eating healthy foods getting checkups and exercising to stay strong and healthy.
Barney has a tee-rific surprise as Cousin Riff moves to town. They can't decide what to do, so the friends put on a puppet show to spend the day having fun
BJ brings a toy plane to the park, Riff takes it apart, and Baby Bop wants a big boat. BJ and Riff surprise her with a sailing ship on the playset
Baby Bop loses her pet caterpillar Monty and finds him inside a chrysalis. BJ sets up a bug zoo and Riff overcomes his fear of bugs with Barney's help
